production.selected_treatment: Classic flat illustration with crisp cel shade, round outlined props, bare paper panels, underlined labels and chat bubbles.
production.attention: Only #A9442A is saturated. Clothing, inactive objects, motives, reactions and unresolved conditions are neutral. Never use pack pos or neg as a quiz result or behavioural prediction.
production.world_refresh: Change the framed local object field at narrated changes of focus, approximately every pair of estimated beats. Preserve physical note identity and slots. Exact cadence requires the animatic. Freeze b34 throughout its answer-hidden silence.
production.template_binding: Templates are layouts on physical objects, not full-screen slides. Bind document.page's page to the note in design.elements; compare sides to two note regions; recap tokens to existing work objects; grid items to adjacent constraint props. A required document title is the note's small header, not a floating lesson title. Retire the previous header and text before replacement.
production.hybrid_contract: Allocated hybrid scenes remain template scenes with a design.motion_layer and spoken-anchor beat_sheet. The layer changes a slot, unmasks a field, draws a pointer or exposes an unanswered margin. It never animates a colleague completing the requested action.
production.held_contract: On continue, take all named keep objects through ctx.held. Held objects do not replay template entrances. If content changes inside page, keep the shell and untouched slots; retire only the specified old slot. Retiring content must leave before its replacement enters. No persistent exit:none text outside the keep set.
production.builder_fallback: If template-local motion binding is unsupported, use the same complete design as a bespoke motion-family scene for that hybrid. Retain the template treatment as an alternative; do not substitute silently.
production.figures: Use approved neutral rigs only, in neutral clothes. No improvised figure drawing, performed hand, invented facial acting or crowd. Non-figurative desk framing is the fallback for missing illustrated colleagues or resting hands. Presenter asset availability must be verified before rendering allocated avatar beats.
production.camera: One shot.move at most. No generic drifting push. Local detail changes use static focus or an explicitly named material join. No moving grain.
production.timing: Use source audio alignment when available. Allocation est_s values are planning estimates, not verified timestamps. All build anchors below are supplied narration word runs. Never infer a pause duration from b34 est_s.
